wuyoscar-gpt-image2-skill-get-prompt-fro.description: Analyze user-provided reference images and reverse-engineer high-fidelity AI image-generation prompts. Use when the user asks to recreate, imitate, reverse-engineer, or extract prompts from photographs, illustrations, 3D renders, products, characters, landscapes, typography, logos, posters, or other visual references. Do not use for requests that only require OCR or an ordinary image description.

wuyoscar-gpt-image2-skill-gpt-image.description: Generate or edit images through the packaged CLI and Reference Gallery, defaulting to GPT Image 2.6 Flare. Use for posters, typography, reference edits, inpainting, native GIFs, sprite animation, image-led websites, and explicit Image 2/2.5/2.6 requests.
